annotations.title: TIA — create or replace one block or type from SIMATIC SD text

description: Creates or REPLACES ONE block or PLC data type from SIMATIC SD text (`s7dcl`, plus `s7res` YAML texts). The only way to create a block or type from SD text (the VCI tools update mapped objects only). An existing object is replaced where it lives; a new one goes to the root group or to `group` (an existing user group, '/'-separated; 404 not_found if missing). No undo. The text must declare exactly the object named by kind and name (400 sd_declaration_mismatch). OBs: an existing OB of ANY event class is refused (409 sd_existing_ob_unsupported): TIA gives every OB imported from SD a new number (a ProgramCycle OB 123 came back as OB 1), even with S7_BlockNumber; use tia_export_block and tia_import_xml to change one and keep its number and event class. A new OB from SD becomes ProgramCycle, numbered by TIA; the receipt (blocks[0].number, eventClass) names them when it could be read (blocks null with receiptError otherwise). Global DBs: the text carries no IsOnlyStoredInLoadMemory, IsWriteProtectedInAS, DBAccessibleFromOPCUA, so an import resets all three; changeImpact.dbAttributeChanges reports them and nothing is restored: IsOnlyStoredInLoadMemory and IsWriteProtectedInAS can be restored with tia_block_set_attribute; DBAccessibleFromOPCUA is set again by a person in TIA Portal (the block's properties) when that route refuses it; then compile. Text rules (TIA V21): comments only through the .s7res texts: `//` inside a LAD/FBD network is refused (in SCL networks it is an ordinary comment); quote a YAML value that contains `:` or `#`; FBD: a `wire#` consumer rung comes before its producer rung and every box output pin is listed (an empty `et =>` is allowed). Checked before anything is written, in a dryRun too (plan: action create|replace, group, dbFlagsReset): expectedContentHash (from tia_export_sd, tia_export_block or tia_export_type: a different current hash is 409 state_changed, an inconsistent object 409 inconsistent; a match returns contentGuard), 409 sd_kind_mismatch, 409 sd_group_mismatch, 409 know_how_protected, 409 name_collision (new block). TIA's refusal of the text is 400 sd_import_failed with its messages (details.changed false = nothing changed, null = unverified), a partly applied one 409 sd_import_partial: never reported as done. The object comes back inconsistent: compile before download. dryRun first (Gd11). Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/sd/import. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

expectedContentHash.description: Stale-write guard (optional): the `contentHash` of the object as you last read it (64 hex characters). The serve verifies it before writing, in a dryRun too. Omit it when creating a new object.

group.description: user group for an object that does not exist yet ('/'-separated); omit for the root; for an existing object omit it or name the group it lives in

kind.description: block (OB, FB, FC, global or instance DB) or type (a PLC data type)

name.description: name of the block or type the text declares

plc.description: PLC software name from tia_plcs.name, not the device station name

s7dcl.description: the text of the .s7dcl file (LF or CRLF; the serve writes it as UTF-8 with BOM and CRLF)

s7res.description: the text of the .s7res file (YAML multilingual texts); omit when the object has none
